reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that monitors session-created or downloaded files and provides a right-side panel for previewing, opening, revealing, and copying file paths.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 文件面板插件，可自动显示会话中新创建或下载的文件，并支持预览、打开、在文件夹中定位和复制路径。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness file panel that automatically lists files created or downloaded during a session and supports previewing, opening, revealing, and copying their paths.

capabilities: Observes files created or downloaded during a session
Previews observed image and text files
Reads metadata for other observed file types
Opens observed files with the operating system default application
Reveals observed files in the operating system file manager
Copies observed absolute file paths to the clipboard
Provides a shortcut to open the session workspace folder
Stores panel state and auto-popup preference in localStorage
